notes: Most of the book uses glyph-encoded fonts. New full-page OCR of chapter openers p87 (USA), p151 (EU) and p269 (Sahel) gives each chapter's printed lesson table (الدروس/العنوان/التوقيت): USA, EU and Sahel lessons taken from those tables (chapter-name prefix dropped from lesson names; 'ملف منهجي تقييمي' excluded). EU chapter title from heading p151; Brazil title from heading p229 ('البرازيل : بلد صناعي جديد'), its two lessons and axis-1 lessons kept from the earlier hand-decoding of encoded headings/time-plan p4 (less certain). Axis titles: axis 1 'مجال عالمي مترابط ومتفاوت' from hand-decoded p4 (not OCR-confirmed); axis 2 printed as 'الشمال : الأقطاب ... في المجال العالمي' (p86, middle word unreadable) kept as 'الشمال'; axis 3 decoded as 'الجنوب'. USA chapter title on p87 is garbled after 'الولايات'; given as 'الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية' as printed in its lesson titles. No positional placeholders, but axis titles 1-3 are partial/decoded.
